children: Poste Italiane said it would become the owner of about 86% of Telecom Italia based on the provisional results of the reopening of its takeover offer.
Italy's state-controlled postal service said that, if the provisional results are confirmed, it will hold around 85.822% of TIM's share capital.

In July, Telecom Italia's board of directors had supported an offer from Poste Italiane, the group's largest shareholder, to take full control of the company. The offer was valued at more than 13 billion euros ($14.81 billion) shortly before its formal launch.
Earlier this month, Telecom Italia said its top executives had tendered their shares into Poste Italiane's voluntary public tender offer.
The payment for the shares tendered during the reopening is expected on October 2.
